summary: Minds Platform (mindsdb/minds superproject): the cowork-server FastAPI+SQLModel backend that persists projects, conversations/messages, skills, schedules+scheduled runs, files, pins, settings, channel installations/bindings/events, plus flat-file memory, a connection vault (LocalDataVault JSON), and artifact publish records. Has full write+read CRUD paths on both a SQLite/Postgres DB and file-backed stores.
